description: When will humanoid robots outnumber humans? Nicolai Tangen sits down with Brian Gu, Vice Chairman and Co-President of XPeng, who describes XPeng as a "physical AI" business rather than just a carmaker. They discuss XPeng's ventures into flying cars and humanoid robots, both built on the same core technology as its vehicles, and a Chinese EV market where new-energy cars now outsell combustion ones. Brian also reflects on his path from a chemistry PhD alongside a future Nobel laureate to a career…
classificationReason: 访谈核心讨论XPeng的physical AI业务、飞行汽车和人形机器人，并探讨其与车辆技术的共性及商业发展。
qualityReason: Substantial transcript evidence shows sustained discussion of EV technology, charging, battery chemistry, development cycles, regulation, robot training data, deployment strategy, and edge-compute capacity. The guest provides informed company and industry knowledge, though the interview is also partly corporate advocacy; the interview format is original but not especially independent or critical.
